title: 坐起后的短延伸
description: 木炭淡彩表现低坐起序列的下一步，脚点与软垫保持近距离。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original charcoal-and-gouache illustration depicts a fictional adult just above a low seated-start position on an indoor bouldering problem. Two broad opposing handholds support the torso, both shoes engage clear low footholds, and the knees remain comfortably bent as one hand prepares a short extension. The hips are close to the continuous crash mat, with no swing or airborne motion. Show a three-quarter wide scene including the whole figure, wall base, and empty padded landing. Use expressive charcoal edges, muted rust clothing, and blue-gray wall washes. Keep adult proportions believable and garments opaque. No words, brands, extreme contortion, dangerous height, or fall depiction.
